biotools.summary: ECO-K is an inverse game theory framework designed to quantify frequency-dependent interaction coefficients among karyotypically defined cancer subpopulations. It applies this approach to model intratumoral ecological dynamics, revealing potential vulnerabilities in tumor evolution.
